subject: [PATCH v5 08/15] SUNRPC: stop the svc_unregister() sweep once rpcbind stops answering

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch modifies the svc_unregister() function to stop sweeping for stale rpcbind entries once it receives no answer from rpcbind. This is done by returning immediately when __svc_unregister() returns -EIO, indicating that rpcbind did not respond. The goal of this change is to reduce the number of timeouts and improve performance in scenarios where a local rpcbind never replies.
